comments.author: @niaschim
comments.text:
So...

I was asleep, I fell asleep with the TV on. I lost interest in a documentary about about AI.

And I dreampt I was shrining in an anime made up version of Japan.

It was very sunny.

There was an old Lady in the dream, but she was napping. We were at a hotel with a small shrine.

Chocolate chip cookies were part of the shrine. I wanted them, but I knew I wasn't supposed to take them unless I did something first. She was asleep, and I didn't want to wake her.

The sun was beginning to set, I didn't want my day to end there, I wanted to do the thing and be on my way to at least one more place.

I looked around for a hint, or some other sign of life, finally someone else arrived, but she was busy, so I started checking my phone to search for an answer, and then there was a commotion.

Someone had brought an officer in and the lady and I approached curiously, as there was suddenly a serious arie in the entry way.

Apparently they ducked in here for refuge from the sun, but it had nothing to do with us, except that they had just been chased by someone derranged.

We were all talking, the officer seemed to know the neighborhood, part of me wanted to ask him about the strange cookie shrine and what I had to do to be allowed to eat one.

The old lady woke up because of the commotion, apparently, while my back was turned she printed out a first time visitor first night free receipt on some thermal paper and handed it to me.

Some of the cookies were missing, which was all I could think about, I was sweaty from being in the sun, and the sun was beginning to cast longer shadows, I felt trapped here like a fly on fly paper.

Now that she was awake, I composed myself, and explained, those cookies over there look delicious but it's clearly part of some shrine so I don't want to take any unless I do whatever I have to do to be allowed to... I said more or less... then she informed me if I was hungry for them then what I had to do was not have them.

I took a deep deep breath, and felt better.

Somehow being told no, was just as freeing as being told yes. I relaxed and was happy to stay the night there, my rush was gone, because that had been the point the entire time.

Then I was distinctly aware that I was dreaming.

I woke up, I felt like crud, I had fallen asleep with the TV on and it was still on, it was some google guy talking about how he invented AI or was the first to it or some such, and I couldn't care less.

I was about to turn the TV off, but because I felt like crud, I got up, and stretched, and drank water first.

Then, I decided to channel surf a bit, and don't remember how or why, but wound up, on the exact video of a program to easily animate and sometimes optionally automate, little AI characters, not perfectly, but, still, the spirit of something I've wanted to tinker with for awhile now was there, and, I could swear this wasn't a thing when I fell asleep.

Like the dream did a reality warping Santa Clause thing on me.

Either that or life is just cool, you never know man, sometimes that's entirely the point, so I'm hyped.

I'm gonna check this out, it seems lit.

Like, it seems like Bambi in that scene where he didn't have his legs yet, and kept falling over, but it still seems potential-ized. And maybe I can do something meaningful with it, maybe not, I shall check it out, who knows?

Anyways, yeah, dreams and shit 🤣💖👍
